Episodes.Plot: Bullied and neglected, Yennefer accidentally finds a means of escape. Geralt's hunt for a so-called devil goes to hell. Ciri seeks safety in numbers.

Episodes.Plot: Geralt takes on another Witcher's unfinished business in a kingdom stalked by a ferocious beast. At a brutal cost, Yennefer forges a magical new future.

Episodes.Actors: Henry Cavill, Anya Chalotra, Freya Allan
Episodes.Plot: Against his better judgment, Geralt accompanies Jaskier to a royal ball. Ciri wanders into an enchanted forest. Yennefer tries to protect her charges.

Episodes.Plot: With the Continent at risk from Nilfgaard's rising power, Yennefer revisits her past, while Geralt reconsiders his obligation to the Law of Surprise.

Episodes.Writer: Lauren Schmidt Hissrich, Andrzej Sapkowski, Haily Hall
Episodes.Actors: Henry Cavill, Anya Chalotra, Freya Allan
